patch_description: Crossover of the two implementations. The current program (score 0.65) has lower slope changes and false reversals, while the prior program (0.61) uses a smoother RTS-based slope estimate with a reversal gate for the lead compensation. The new program keeps the current pipeline (adaptive-R Kalman + RTS smoother + double zero-phase SG) but replaces the noisy finite-difference slope in Stage 4 with the polished RTS smoothed slope, gated by a softened threshold (0.25 * local noise scale instead of 0.5) and blended slightly with the finite-difference slope for responsiveness. This should reduce slope reversals and false reversals further while keeping lag low. All other logic, inputs, and outputs are unchanged.
